model.what: RNNoise 0.2 (Xiph.Org / Jean-Marc Valin / Mozilla / Amazon), the denoiser compiled to WebAssembly with its trained weights built in, from Jitsi's @jitsi/rnnoise-wasm 0.2.1

derived_from.how: the WebAssembly binary is the base64 data URI inside that file, decoded unchanged (extract_wasm.py); none of the Emscripten glue is used

model.interface: imports a.a (resize heap) and a.b (memcpy); exports c memory, d ctors, e malloc, f free, g rnnoise_init, h rnnoise_create, i rnnoise_destroy, j rnnoise_process_frame
model.checked: lib/listen/pins.ts carries the same digest and length; the worker compares the fetched bytes with both before compiling them
